options.name: core
options.description: The realm sign-in service of a tenant.

settings.name: baseUrl
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_BASE_URL: The browser-facing https origin (the issuer).

settings.name: internalUrl
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_INTERNAL_URL: The in-cluster https origin, when it differs from baseUrl.

settings.name: port
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_PORT: Port the HTTPS listener binds.

settings.name: dataDir
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_DATA: The state folder (signing key, master key, realms, clients, TLS); defaults to data beside the code.

settings.name: secureCookie
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_SECURE_COOKIE: Whether session cookies are Secure (false or 0 turns it off).

settings.name: tenants
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_TENANTS: Tenants whose realms are opened at start (comma-separated ids).

settings.name: adminToken
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_ADMIN_TOKEN_REF: The admin API token (PRAGMATIC_IDP_ADMIN_TOKEN_REF names its file under the data folder secrets).

settings.name: loginDir
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_LOGIN_DIR: Folder of the built sign-in app (defaults to idp-login/dist beside the code).
